TOCA (series).fact: The series originally focused specifically on touring car racing, but after World Touring Cars, the series expanded to cover a wide variety of motorsport.

TOCA (series).subject: Applied Sciences
TOCA (series).question: The TOCA series was eventually succeeded by the Grid series of games, with Race Driver: Grid released in _____
TOCA (series).fact: The TOCA series was eventually succeeded by the Grid series of games, with Race Driver: Grid released in 2008.

TOCA (series).subject: Applied Sciences
TOCA (series).question: Fictional (but realistic) tracks were added, and support races such as _____, Formula Ford and others also arrived
TOCA (series).fact: Fictional (but realistic) tracks were added, and support races such as Ford Fiestas, Formula Ford and others also arrived.

TOCA (series).subject: Applied Sciences
TOCA (series).question: The level of car damage possible during a race was also enhanced, which was a significant selling point compared with the likes of _____
TOCA (series).fact: Featuring all the licensed cars (not including privateers) and tracks from the 1997 British Touring Car Championship, the game was acclaimed by the European games press, especially on console where it was widely considered the best in its genre until the release of Gran Turismo several months later. The level of car damage possible during a race was also enhanced, which was a significant selling point compared with the likes of Gran Turismo.

TOCA (series).question: It was called _____ in the USA
TOCA (series).fact: It was called Touring Car Challenge in the USA.

TOCA (series).subject: Applied Sciences
TOCA (series).question: Unlike the first two titles in the TOCA series, _____ was not released in a Windows version
TOCA (series).fact: Unlike the first two titles in the TOCA series, World Touring Cars was not released in a Windows version.

TOCA (series).subject: Applied Sciences
TOCA (series).question: The game took the series in a new direction, and introduced a plot centering around fictional race driver _____Kane, trying to make a name for himself in a multitude of car championships
TOCA (series).fact: The game took the series in a new direction, and introduced a plot centering around fictional race driver Ryan McKane, trying to make a name for himself in a multitude of car championships. The game continued to use a scripted career mode as introduced in the previous Race Driver game but dropped the Ryan McKane character.

TOCA (series).question: Create and Race is the second racing game developed by _____ to run on the Octane game engine (after Cartoon Network Racing)
